verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for llms.txt at help.angelliststack.com, which indexes the Help Center as markdown links. The help docs are consistently served as clean .md pages (e.g., the tie-out assistant, reports and integrations pages), so an agent can be pointed at them directly. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing or advertising agent-oriented docs, no evidence of llms-full.txt or llms.txt coverage beyond the Stack help center (e.g., angellist.com fund/investor products), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
